tei:div.tei:p: sangs rgyas la yid ches skyes tsa na: brgyud pa'i byin rlabs 'byung bar nges: gong ma la mos pa skyes tsa na: thugs rje'i byin rlabs 'byung bar nges: bla ma la gdung ba skyes tsa na: nyams dang byin rlabs skye bar nges: snang srid chos skur shes tsa na: nyon mongs rang sar grol bar nges: ye grol gcer bzhag gis rgyas thebs na: sangs rgyas dgongs pa yin par nges: lus ngag bde ba rnyed tsa na: bla ma'i byin rlabs yin par nges: 'khrul pa phyi rol gyi snang ba 'gags tsa na: rang gi rtsol ba yin par nges: de ltar rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor bdag : 'khor 'das ru shan phyed pas bde: zhes lce btsun gyi mgur ro: athi+-i: dza yantu: 'di man dkar chag na mi snang : PAGE - PAGE 61 -
